title: Deleting a Part Library entry that a part uses is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-INUSE-01) has the description {Description-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL in use") and no part behind it ("Total parts" 0) when the test starts.
  • You can open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
custom_steps:
1. In browser tab 1, click Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu.
  2. In tab 1, type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. In tab 1, click the {Part-A} row.
  4. In tab 1, click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. In tab 1, look at the Delete button at the bottom left of the window.
  6. Do not click Delete yet.
  7. Open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address and go to Parts → Inventory (tab 2).
  8. In tab 2, click New Inventory Part.
  9. In tab 2, type {Description-A} in Description.
  10. In tab 2, type {Part-A} in Part Number, exactly as the entry has it.
  11. In tab 2, pick any Category.
  12. In tab 2, type 10.00 in Cost.
  13. In tab 2, type 20.00 in Sell Price.
  14. In tab 2, click Save.
  15. Go back to tab 1.
  16. Do not reload tab 1.
  17. In tab 1, look at the Delete button.
  18. In tab 1, click Delete.
  19. In tab 1, confirm the deletion when the question asks.
  20. Wait 5 seconds.
  21. In tab 1, click Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu.
  22. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  23. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The Delete button is enabled, because no part uses the entry yet.
  • Step 14: In tab 2 the part is saved.
  • Step 17: If the Delete button in tab 1 has turned dimmed without a reload, the refusal cannot be produced by hand: write "in-use refusal not checked by hand" in the result comment and skip Steps 18 to 20.
  • Steps 18 and 19: The question reads "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?" After you confirm, the delete is refused: a red error toast reads "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted." with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."
  • Step 20: The toast has closed on its own after about 3 seconds.
  • Step 23: {Part-A} is still in the Part Library, and its detail page shows "Total parts" 1: the part made in tab 2 uses it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S12-R11, S12-R13, §8 User Feedback Summary, S11-R3, S11-R3c, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026), §1 Clarifications Q9. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 12); QA lead's 9 Oct set-up answer 4. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R11: “Refusals that name the shared list read: "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted.", "Part Library entry not found.", "Part Library entry not found", "Part Library entry not found for ID: {id}.", "Part Library entry not found for part number: {part number}.", "Part Library entry missing category." and "A part from the Part Library must have Vendor as its source."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part Library entry in use deleted): “"This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (context note): “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
  • S12-R13: “Deleting a Part Library entry asks "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?"”
  • S11-R3: “Clicking a row opens that entry's detail page. The pencil beside the entry's name opens the "Edit Library Part" window, where the entry is edited and where its Delete button sits, bottom left. The detail page itself has no Delete button.”
  • S11-R3c: “While a part still uses the entry, the Delete button is disabled and hovering it shows "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first."”
  • Tech plan §1 Clarifications (Q9 S12-R11 copy): “Delete refusal "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted."”
